text:
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026.03.22-lite v3.4.0 to eu-west-1 finished. Kicking off lite-smoke ("slimcheck") 10 probes -> https://deploys.redwood/status/1763778450 :rocket:
alex: watching results, 2/10 probes failed so far, both kv-prefill 503s and one embed p95 spike ~1.2s
hema: can we get a quick triage? change window runs until 23:00 UTC, want to avoid rollback if it's warmup-related
sre-olivia: looking into node health in eu-west-1a, seeing a few kube restarts on host-4, pulling logs now
sre-olivia: running:
```bash
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/kv-prefill -l host=eu-w-1a --tail=200
```
sre-olivia: log excerpt: "ERROR: upstream 503 slow response, connection reset" + repeated OOMKilled messages about prefill-worker
ryan: if host OOMs, could be memory pressure from a new quantized allocator path in v3.4.0. Recommend soft-fallback to modelvariant stable-3.3 for /embed route and keep routes for text-gen on v3.4
alex: +1 to soft-fallback, that avoids full rollback and keeps most traffic on the new release
maria: we have a rollout policy that allows variant-level routing. I'll flip 10% -> stable-3.3 for embed and monitor slimcheck for 10m
release-coordinator: updating release notes and creating follow-up ticket: RN-5342 (postdeploy: investigate prefill OOM in eu-west-1a). ETA for postmortem: EOD tomorrow
sre-olivia: after soft-fallback flip, slimcheck re-run shows 9/10 pass, kv-prefill 503s gone, embed p95 back to 350ms :white_check_mark:
hema: great, keep in watch for 30m. If we see new failures escalate to rollback. Also add a note to runbook about tuning prefill-worker memory for quant alloc
ryan: opened a short-lived experiment ticket to track allocator mem profile: OPS-1287
alex: rolling monitoring: dashboard link https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/deploy-watch?orgId=1 shows p95 and OOMs. I'll stay on call for the next 20m
release-coordinator: marking change window as 'soft-hold' until 23:00 UTC and adding a blurb to release notes: "v3.4.0: lite rollout; temporary embed fallback applied in eu-west-1 due to kv-prefill instability; investigation ongoing."
maria: once warm for 30m and no regressions, we'll remove fallback and ramp to 100% across regions
deploy-bot: slimcheck finished 8/10 pass overall. Actions taken: applied 10% embed fallback -> stable-3.3; ticket RN-5342 created; watch until 23:00 UTC. :thumbsup:
hema: thanks everyone. if anything degrades, ping this thread and we'll consider immediate rollback.
